metadata.description: Curated collection of skills, hooks, agents and commands for Claude Code by FabienSalles

plugins.name: php
plugins.description: PHP 8.0–8.3 language conventions — code style, OOP, DDD, refactoring, SQL, Composer. Framework-agnostic. Pair with phpunit for testing and symfony for Symfony-specific FormType/Twig/PRG conventions.

plugins.name: phpunit
plugins.description: PHPUnit testing discipline for PHP projects — TDD workflow (red-green-refactor with cross-layer iterations), test writing conventions (DAMP, AAA, Prophecy, factories). Layers on craft:tdd-workflow-principles and craft:testing-principles for the cross-language baseline; PHPUnit-specific commands and Prophecy examples live here.

plugins.name: symfony
plugins.description: Personal Symfony conventions — FormType design (data_class as single source of truth, DataTransformer placement), Twig component patterns (trans_default_domain isolation), Post/Redirect/Get for HTML controllers, and testing anything that boots a Symfony kernel (WebTestCase built-in assertions, TypeTestCase, container doubles). Use alongside php (language) and phpunit (framework-agnostic testing). Distinct from atournayre/symfony — these are personal overlays.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript conventions, typing, DDD events, functional programming, OOP, refactoring

plugins.name: astro
plugins.description: Astro 5.x — components, routing, collections, i18n, SEO, Tailwind, React islands, transitions

plugins.name: nest
plugins.description: NestJS architectural conventions, DDD with NestJS

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend clean architecture (hexagonal), Container/Presentation patterns

plugins.name: jquery
plugins.description: jQuery code conventions — module structure with exported init function, js-* selector classes, per-block scoping, symmetric toggleClass over imperative show/hide helpers. Framework-agnostic (works with any backend / build system).

plugins.name: vitest
plugins.description: Vitest TDD workflow, test conventions and patterns

plugins.name: tooling
plugins.description: Docker, Drizzle ORM, pnpm workspaces, Zod schemas, Claude Code plugin conventions, npx skills conventions

plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Shared hooks, agents, commands, skills across projects

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Transverse git & PR discipline — ref freshness (fetch first), branch/commit/PR conventions, force-push and worktree guardrails. Merges the former PR-creation skill.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Cross-language software craftsmanship principles — refactoring, DDD, OOP, TDD, testing, code style — that complement language-specific example skills (php-*, ts-*, etc.)

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Claude Code statusline — cwd, git branch, model, context progress bar, 5h rate limit

plugins.name: mac
plugins.description: macOS / BSD platform discipline — shell/bash 3.2 vs Homebrew bash 5+, BSD vs GNU command portability, common macOS pitfalls

plugins.name: audit
plugins.description: Audit hub — personal overrides for upstream audit skills + stack-specific code patterns (security for TS/NestJS, PHP planned). Loads in parallel with netresearch/security-audit.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Security audit patterns (OWASP, CWE, CVSS) with 80+ checkpoints — by Netresearch

plugins.name: security-runtime
plugins.description: Runtime security hooks: CLAUDE.md injection scanner (SessionStart) + Bash prompt injection detector (PreToolUse)

plugins.name: goal
plugins.description: Chantier→spec→plan→unattended run workflow for Claude Code: cut an initiative into an ordered just-in-time backlog (/goal:tickets), settle the functional contract of any source — Jira US (via MCP), GitHub issue, spec file or inline — with a grilled, observable Definition of Done (/goal:spec), lock the executable plan into gate-blocked iterations (/goal:plan), then let the runner execute it unattended, each slice judged by a program (goal-gate.ts) that runs the declared command and is the only thing allowed to commit — watched to the end by /goal:supervise, with /goal:next as the checkpoint between two iterations. GitHub, commit and PR are all opt-in, never forced.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Cherry-picked obra/superpowers skills: verification-before-completion (evidence before claims), systematic-debugging (root-cause-first)

plugins.name: pocock
plugins.description: Cherry-picked mattpocock/skills: grill-me (relentless interview before code), grill-with-docs (interview + CONTEXT.md/ADR docs), zoom-out (broader-context request)

plugins.name: self-audit
plugins.description: Deep comparative audit of external Claude skill packs against this marketplace, weighted by my real Claude usage profile, plus a repo structure + documentation health pass. Produces versioned gap-analysis backlogs under audits/. Run via /self-audit:compare <target>.

plugins.name: marketing-content
plugins.description: Content & copywriting playbooks — LinkedIn posts, SEO blog articles, direct-response copy, editing pass, editorial strategy, content calendar, content repurposing, SEO briefs, technical SEO audit, schema markup.

plugins.name: marketing-strategy
plugins.description: Strategic marketing — ICP definition, persuasion psychology (70+ mental models), 139 marketing ideas, competitor analysis, positioning/GTM (April Dunford), shared product-marketing context.

plugins.name: marketing-distribution
plugins.description: Distribution channels — multi-platform social posts (Reddit/Twitter/X/LinkedIn/IG/FB/TikTok), Twitter threads and long Reddit posts, email subject lines, newsletter growth.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product delivery discipline — slice any functional spec into thin vertical iterations (vertical-slice: 17 splitting techniques + a method to choose and combine them per feature, technical constraint and execution mode), and ship each one without blocking (delivery: feature flags sized to the project, additive no-BC-break change, expand/contract, and the cleanup that closes the loop once it's in prod).

plugins.name: marketing-analytics
plugins.description: Marketing analytics — tracking setup (GA4/GTM/UTM/tracking plan), Google Analytics Data API reporting, Google Search Console reporting.

plugins.name: release
plugins.description: Automatic semver release discipline for this marketplace — every PR that touches a plugin's shipped content bumps its version (major.minor.patch) in plugin.json and marketplace.json, classified from the conventional commits since the plugin's last bump.
